text:
nora-marketing: FYI ops flagged degraded throughput in EU region (eu-1). Need customer-facing status copy + timing. Also we have a product webinar in 90m  what's the recommended stance?

vik-ops: spike started ~13:07 UTC. elevated p95 + intermittent 5xx for embeddings/completions. rolling-restart in progress. ETA unsure, will update in 20m. No signs of data exposure.

jules-cs: Priority: short status page line, AM paste-able one-liner, and a Dedicated/private email template. Also guidance for marking inbound leads affected by the outage.

kai-sales: For leads: ask SDRs to tag leads as "potentially impacted: EU" in CRM and pause any performance demos for affected accounts.

anita-prod: Webinar: recommend removing live perf demos and pause any benchmark announcements. We can proceed with roadmap slides and Q&A.

nora-marketing: Draft status copy (v0):
"Incident: Elevated latency and errors in EU inference region
Impact: Some customers may see slow responses or request errors for generation and embeddings routed to EU.
What we're doing: Engineers are investigating and performing remediation; requests may be retried or routed per customer settings.
Next update: 30 minutes"

vik-ops: tweak: "requests may be retried or routed per customer settings" -> "if your configuration allows, retries or non-EU routing may reduce errors". Avoid promising routing.

jules-cs: Legal: avoid SLA language. Also add CTA for Dedicated/private to open a ticket for priority assistance.

legal-bot: Confirmed: use "may be impacted" phrasing. No SLA language or guaranteed routing.

nora-marketing: AM one-liner for account teams: "We're seeing elevated latency and intermittent errors in the EU inference region; engineers are mitigating. Expected update in ~30m. For priority help, open a support ticket and reference 'EU inference impact.'"

kai-sales: Good. SDR/AM play: tag CRM leads and include one-liner in outreach. Will brief SDR huddle now.

jules-cs: Draft Dedicated email template:
Subject: Support: Temporary routing assistance for EU latency
Hi {{first_name}},
We're experiencing elevated latency and intermittent errors for requests routed to our EU region. If you are on Dedicated/Private and need temporary routing assistance, please open a ticket referencing "EU inference impact" and we'll prioritize the change.
Estimated next update: 30 minutes.
Thanks,
Redwood Support

nora-marketing: Timing plan: (1) publish status page now once wording final, (2) AM one-liner to account teams immediately, (3) Dedicated email within 45m after ops confirms manual routing availability, (4) postpone any benchmark/social posts until postmortem. Webinar swap to roadmap/Q&A.

vik-ops: I'll confirm routing availability in 15m. Rolling restart continues.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 created  severity: high  owner: vik-ops.

nora-marketing: Drop a :white_check_mark: when aligned so I can push updates.

jules-cs: \u2705 support template ready to send after ops signoff.

kai-sales: \u2705 briefing sent to SDRs; CRM tag created.

anita-prod: \u2705 webinar slides revised (removed live perf).

vik-ops: \u2705 will update with routing confirmation or resolution.

nora-marketing: Publishing status copy now. Will coordinate Dedicated mail after ops confirm. Thanks everyone.
